answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 12 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 880 identities costs 880 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the trellis here is verification, the tundra of cost is what stops the farm, and the quill of the record keeps every claim checkable.
